CustomField.description: What the answer counts for, for sums and averages. For a choice: the score set for the option in the Form Builder; with none set, the number itself for a list of numbers (a 1 to 5 rating) and the place in the list, low to high, for a worded scale the package ships. For a Likert section in Number mode: the number chosen. Blank for every other answer, so an average of Score counts scored questions only. A number the respondent entered is in Number Value, not here.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What this answer counts for. Blank when the question is not scored.
CustomField.label: Score
